## Featured Platforms

- [ChatGPT Plus](https://openai.com/chatgpt): World standard AI assistant powered by OpenAI GPT-4o.
- [Claude 3.5 Sonnet](https://claude.ai): Top coding AI model for developers.
- [Sora AI](https://openai.com/sora): Cinematic text-to-video model with 1080p camera motion.
- [XusCRM](https://xuscrm.com): Purpose-built real estate CRM for UAE brokerages with Bayut and Property Finder sync.
- [Cursor AI](https://cursor.com): AI-first code editor powered by Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
- [Suno AI](https://suno.com): Generative AI music production studio.
- [GoHighLevel](https://gohighlevel.com): All-in-one marketing agency CRM and automated sales funnels.
